notes.title: Gameplay update 1.3 now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/f9273f92539807e3894b8b47ee9366d527bca917.jpg[/img]
Hello to all,
we arrived at the gameplay update 1.3, with great improvements for the playability and variety of maps.

[h1]Automatic deactivation![/h1]
Now the deactivation of the generators is almost automatic, with the energy aura enlarging independently next to the selected generator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/bd93a9b99b8216fabbaf6960b45a808f1557783f.jpg[/img]
[h1]Improved health objects![/h1]
Visualization and management of health objects has been improved, which now also offer many more points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/434e01200c4df25223cc551b2c9e697116b65269.jpg[/img]
[h1]Greater variety of procedural maps![/h1]
The procedural generation of maps has been improved, [b]with the addition of semi-flat and completely flat maps[/b].
This was also done to lighten and facilitate gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/c228e08d0ad6f0002664306715e5f2326dc92733.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gameplay Update 1.2 now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/1e1b7e0be34fb7bdb8179b6ea70a859c028b4779.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,
we have released another gameplay update, version 1.2!
[h1]New platform management[/h1]
Now the position of the platforms with the generators has been improved, and the annoying large holes that were under the structures have been eliminated.
By this way it is much easier to achieve the mission objectives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/b4f34b1dd14dda9239a5e64884454f46827c35b7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/4651ccc9f5eae5dcbaa10f4147869665b8950b47.jpg[/img]
[h1]New management of the VIGOR[/h1]
The collection of these fundamental Vigor objects will now simply increase the speed of our hero, but will not decrease performance during the mission.
If the autonomy of the robot is at zero, then the speed will return to normal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/fb24db8f9da87101c312fc38ed18b16a2ad34e20.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/754e78b9264596bc9408a05877b168232f51ecff.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Gameplay Update 1.1 now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/092f10abbc1133a7bd60c7095f14e4b461bee13c.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,
we have simplified the gameplay and greatly improved the interface of the game during the missions.
Now the game-loop is much clearer and more fluid.

The aim of the game is to deactivate all the generators to pass the levels.
[b]Kill enemies --> Take ENERGY bonuses --> Deactivate the selected generator through the energy aura --> Deactivate all generators in the level --> Return to the extraction point to win![/b]
You can also modify the terrain to reach the targets of the missions!
[h1]Controls:[/h1]
[b]Mouse/arrows --> Move
Fire1 key --> Shoot
Hold Jump key --> Enter in trace mode/jump
Esc key --> Pause game
F1 key --> Tutorial
Tab key --> Select weapon
Q,E keys --> Destroy/Add terrain at selected position[/b]

To enter in 'deactivation mode' and to deform the terrain, you need energy.
This energy can be earned by collecting the many bonuses that appear every time you kill an enemy!
The energy decreases every second.
Take the VIGOR objects to increase the AMMO and AUTONOMY.
Take the 'health items' when you turn off a power generator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178992/7d4101b119285cc32c9013df3022a10c5ba33538.jpg[/img]
